evidence: GTPlanet thread 'It's Chriiiiiiiistmas in GT Sport!!!' (posts dated 2018-12-21): Christmas menu music started at local midnight on 21 December; a player reported not hearing it the day before.
Posts in the same thread on 2018-12-25 still describe Christmas-only menu music.
MotoGamesTV recordings of the GT Sport Christmas menu were published 2019-12-20 17:15 PST, 2020-12-21 01:00 PST and 2022-12-20 15:48 PST, all of which are 21 December in Japan and Europe.
christmasWindow.approximation: The end date is not evidenced. No source shows when the Christmas playlist stopped, so the window ends on 25 December, the last date with direct reports. Use the Christmas setting to force it.

christmasMusic.summary: Update 1.10 (22 December 2017) added Christmas music to the main menu, and it came back each December. The three Christmas tracks play from the archive.org fan upload listed below.

reportedTitles.title: Jingle Bells
reportedTitles.evidence: GTPlanet, 2018-12-21: 'exited back to menus and, voila - Jingle Bells all the way'

reportedTitles.title: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
reportedTitles.evidence: GTPlanet, 2018-12-21: 'it starts on We Wish You A Merry Christmas'

christmasMusic.gaps: Arrangers are unidentified. Silent Night is in the archive upload but no dated GT Sport player report names it.

menuMusic.summary: Menu tracks play natively from an anonymous archive.org fan upload, 'Gran Turismo Complete Soundtrack', streamed straight from archive.org's per-file links. Nothing is rehosted here. Embedded ID3 comments point to the Sitting on Clouds fan OST site. Licensing is not stated by the uploader.
menuMusic.gaps: Four tracks from the GTPlanet community menu list are not in the upload and are not played. Post-launch menu additions (GT League and legacy GT tracks) are not included.
